headline: Dyno Nobel Shares Hit Multi-Year High on Heavy Volume: What Is Driving DNL? - The Bull
summary: Dyno Nobel shares closed at a multi-year high of A$3.83 after a 83% surge in half-year profit. The company's transformation into a pure-play explosives business drove the move.
why: Dyno Nobel is an Australian explosives maker serving mining customers, so its results signal demand in the resources sector.
